class.name: HTMLDataTransfer
class.brief_description: The limited text payload available to clipboard events.
class.description: This implementation supports only [code]text/plain[/code]. Data passed to a [code]paste[/code] event is read-only; [code]copy[/code] and [code]cut[/code] handlers may replace the copied text.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns the payload for [code]text/plain[/code], or an empty string for an unsupported type.

method.name: set_data
method.description: Sets the [code]text/plain[/code] payload unless this transfer is read-only.

method.name: clear_data
method.description: Clears the text payload when the transfer is writable. An empty type clears all supported data.

method.name: get_types
method.description: Returns the supported data types currently present.
